svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif
svg.title: ERD: users, orders, order_items, payments

g.title: user_id bigint Customer index idx_user_id ~> users.id
